rule: Retrieval-only experiments first. Freeze the selected exact evidence, then vary only decoder; precision fallback is a separate experiment.

final_composition.rule: R0-R8 are component ablations. Only validation evidence admits components; measure interactions, not sums of individual gains. No automatic feature activation.
final_composition.graph_expansion: new candidates; separate axis from graph features
final_composition.graph_features: soft ranking evidence on existing candidates; OFF until separately justified
final_composition.selection_identity: full config + git + corpus + model revisions + benchmark manifest; immutable before holdout
final_composition.freeze: after explicit final selection and authorized confirmations; ordered top 8 including text/provenance/scores for B
